ai_summary: India Power Corporation Limited, currently under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP), has received regulatory notices and fines totaling Rs. 2.42 Lakhs from NSE and MSE for delayed submission of its FY2025-26 Annual Report. The company attributes this non-compliance to operational challenges stemming from its CIRP status, including difficulties obtaining shareholder data due to pre-CIRP dues and inability to file for AGM extensions, necessitating NCLT intervention. This ongoing CIRP and the associated regulatory non-compliance are significant red flags, potentially leading to further actions like freezing promoter demat accounts or shifting the scrip to a restrictive trading category.
